title: Project: Zen Utilities
description: This is a utility mod for the official Project: Zen mod pack, it is only intended to be used in a mod pack as the items are unobtainable with just this mod
body:
**Project: Zen - Utilities** is the dedicated content expansion mod for the Project: Zen modpack. It serves as a central hub for custom assets, unique entities, and specialized items tailored specifically for the pack's progression and world-building.

# 📦 Purpose
This mod provides the "physical" content that other mods or scripts in the Project: Zen ecosystem interact with. By centralizing these assets, we can offer a more cohesive and unique experience that isn't possible with existing mods alone.

# 🧬 Planned Content
While the mod is constantly evolving alongside the pack, it is built to house:

- Custom Cobblemon: Unique species and variants exclusive to the Project: Zen world.
- Decorative & Functional Blocks: New building materials and utility blocks.
- Unique Items: Crafting components and special consumables (like the IV Candy Base).
- Custom Entities & GUIs: Bespoke interfaces and mobs to enhance immersion.

# 🛠 Implementation Details
Please note that **Project: Zen - Utilities** is an asset provider.

No Default Recipes: To allow for total control over pack balance, items do not have default recipes.

Modpack Dependency: This mod is designed to be used within the Project: Zen modpack. If used standalone, the items and entities will exist in-game but will require external tools (like KubeJS or datapacks) to be obtainable in survival.
